title: Render bug (catalog entry)
description: One known rendering bug: a reusable signature that matches future findings, the root cause, and the fix recipe. The catalog is append-only JSONL (catalog/bugs.jsonl), one bug per line, ordered by id. It lives in the PRIVATE QA repo because occurrences name real question ids.

title.description: What a student sees, in plain words.

signature.description: How triage recognises a new finding as this bug. A finding matches when its check is in `checks` AND every present constraint holds. When several bugs match, the one with the most constraints wins; ties go to the lower id.

evidence_regex.description: Regex (ECMAScript / Python compatible subset) over evidence.snippet + ' ' + JSON(metrics).

raw_regex.description: Regex over the raw source field the finding points at.

paths.description: Render paths where the bug appears (live = live/mock exam).

app_sha_range.description: Optional '<first-bad-sha>..<fixed-sha>' so findings from builds that contain the fix stop matching.

explanation.description: Why it happens, with file:line at a named commit when it is code.

recipe.description: Exact, repeatable steps. For data fixes: the before -> after transformation, e.g. a regex rewrite, so the next occurrence can be fixed the same way.

data_transform.description: Optional machine-applicable rewrite, e.g. 's/\\,\^/\\,{}^/g' on math segments. Staged, never auto-applied.

regression_test.description: repo:path of the test that fails without the fix.

workaround_for_old_builds.description: What to do in data for students on an app build without the fix.

synthetic_repro.description: A hand-written minimal input that reproduces the bug. Never real question text.

occurrences.description: Append one entry per paper review in which the bug was seen.

resolution.description: e.g. fixed in data before the test, accepted by <name>.
